title: SIDESTORY: NEAR LIGHT RERUN
lines: 01 SIDE STORY: NEAR LIGHT RERUN
EVENT DURATION: April 14, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7) – April 28, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 1-10
DETAILS: Near Light event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages, completing the
event missions, and redeeming from the event shop.
EVENT STAGES DURATION:
- [Kawalerielki] Duration: April 14, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7) – April 24, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
- [Area 0] Duration: April 14, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7) – April 24, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
- [City Neon] Duration: April 14, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7) – April 24, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
[YOUR DESK - LONG-TERM GOALS]
DETAILS: During the event, players can complete [Your Desk - Long-Term Goals] missions by clearing event stages to gain rewards.
MAIN REWARDS: ★★★★★: Wild Mane, Kazimierz Broadcast Center (Pieces), G.K.T. Commemorative Models.
[TRADE EXHIBITION]
DURATION: April 14, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7) – April 28, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)

DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain G.K.T. Commemorative Models by clearing event stages and Long-Term Goals missions. G.K.T. Commemorative Models can be used to redeem items from [Trade Exhibition].
MAIN REWARDS: Wild Mane's Token, Kazimierz Broadcast Center (Pieces), Headhunting Permit, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, etc.
NOTE:

- The requirements to obtain certain medals of this event have been updated. Players who have participated in the original event and met the adjusted requirements will receive the corresponding medals once log in.
- Once the rerun ends, the Medal Set of this event can no longer be obtained via any method, including the [Side Story].
- This event rerun will carry on the stage progress and First Clear progress.

- The once-only rewards in the rerun will automatically be converted to Intelligence Certificates for players who have already claimed them. Please refer to [Intelligence Certificate Conversion Rules] for more details.
- [Intelligence Certificate Area] will be restocked as the event rerun begins. In addition, new redeemable will be added.
- Operators Nearl the Radiant Knight, Flametail, Corroserum, Wild Mane, and ‘Justice Knight’ will gain more trust during the event rerun.
- The event stages will be permanently added to the [Side Story] after the end of the event at 04:00 on April 28 (UTC-7).
02 EPOQUE COLLECTION NEW ARRIVALS AT OUTFIT STORE
DURATION: April 14, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7) – April 28, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The following Outfit will be available at the Store, including:
EPOQUE Collection - Justice Maker for Wild Mane
03 WITCH FEAST SERIES RE-EDITION AT OUTFIT STORE
DURATION: April 14, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7) – April 28, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The following Re-edition Outfits will be available at the Store, including:
Witch Feast Series - Moon Catastrborn for Blemishine
Witch Feast Series - Echo of the Horrorlair for Shamare
Witch Feast Series - Fated Hero for Snowsant
04 RE-EDITION FURNITURE SET – KAZIMIERZ BROADCAST CENTER
DURATION: April 14, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7) – April 28, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: This furniture set will be available again during the event.
HOW TO OBTAIN:
- Near Light event rewards and redeem in Trade Exhibition (Pieces)
- Limited-time sale at the Store (Pieces)
